scope: Frame the bench clamp teaching task and draft requirements. No project evidence is supplied. This artifact does not establish an approved requirements baseline or demonstrate product performance.

conditions.text: The task specifies bench teaching only and the desired outcome of holding a workpiece without visible damage.
Load and workpiece material are explicitly unknown.

payload.actor: Bench teaching participant; operator identity, experience and needs are unknown.
payload.boundary: bench teaching only; load and material unknown
payload.desired_outcome: hold a workpiece without visible damage

requirements.text: The bench clamp should hold the workpiece during the defined teaching activity.
requirements.acceptance: Pending clarification of workpiece geometry, load magnitude and direction, holding duration and permissible movement. A verification procedure can be planned once these conditions are agreed; no result is available.

requirements.text: Clamping and release should leave the workpiece without visible damage.
requirements.acceptance: Pending agreement on material, initial surface condition, what counts as damage, and viewing conditions. A before-and-after inspection is a proposed verification direction only; no inspection has occurred.

requirements.text: The scope of this clamp study should remain limited to bench teaching.
requirements.acceptance: Review the study brief and any later verification plan against the task boundary; operating conditions within bench teaching still require clarification.

conditions.text: Actual slipping, damage, its causes and its consequences have not been documented in the supplied input.
Requirement ownership, approval authority and change authority are unspecified. Requirements remain drafts; later revisions should retain the reason for change and affected requirements.
Specific performance thresholds and implementation choices remain unresolved until the teaching activity and operating conditions are clarified.
